notes.title: Progress Update on Controller Support
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Last week I received my Steam Deck and have since been working on getting the game controller ready.
It's taken me a bit more time than expected, so apologies for the delay. The Gameplay and UI navigation are both nearly complete, but still need alot of polish and testing. I will keep you all updated with any news, and as always, thank you for your support.

, Sean Griffiths

notes.title: Network Fixes In Progress
notes.notes:
Hello!

Lately it's been pointed out that there are some networking issues, specifically disconnecting happening between players.

The issue seems to be caused by high ping and packet loss over the network. These issues are being worked on, so you may see alot of updates flying in! 

After the networking issues are resolved, I will be going back to more content based updates and general bug fixes (announcements posted here and in the Discord). 

An important aspect of this game is for players to have a good time with friends, so getting the networking resolved is currently the top priority. 

Thank you for your patience and understanding, and please feel free to reach out with any comments or concerns.

Sean Griffiths

https://discord.gg/CvVzNAAhQR
